spell.hogwartsmagic.expelliarmus.desc: Knocks the item out of a target's hand and silences wand-users for 2 seconds (up to 4 at Master); a disarmed player can't grab it back until then. At Master, disarming the Elder Wand's holder, or Voldemort himself, makes the Elder Wand yours.
spell.hogwartsmagic.glacius.desc: Chills and slows the target; a second hit soon after freezes it solid and leaves it brittle. Fire thaws it. Turns water into ice. At Master, frozen enemies shatter when they die.
spell.hogwartsmagic.confringo.desc: A fiery combat blast that sets its targets alight but never harms the ground. Higher ranks hit harder and spread the flames to nearby enemies. At Master it hits brittle (frozen) targets half again as hard.
spell.hogwartsmagic.protego.desc: A 3-second shield that faces where you look and blunts blows from the front (40%, up to 75% at Master). Time it: a spell that hits in the first moment is parried. Adept reflects it at random, Expert back at its caster, Master refunds half the mana and knocks melee attackers back. The Unforgivables are never reflected.
spell.hogwartsmagic.protego_maxima.desc: Aim upward and hold cast to sustain a skyward beam that slowly drains mana while forming a large protective bubble, or cast on a ward to raise its barrier.
spell.hogwartsmagic.lumos.desc: A light that follows you (brighter from Adept); cast again for Nox. Left-click always toggles it. From Expert, right-click casts Lumos Maxima: a floating orb of light where it lands (up to 3, for 5 minutes). At Master the beam is Lumos Solem, searing and blinding undead and spiders.
spell.hogwartsmagic.accio.desc: Summons creatures (up to 10 hearts at Novice, any non-boss at Master) and loose items near where it lands. From Expert it pulls the first stack out of a chest you could open; at Master it snatches an opponent's held item in a duel.
spell.hogwartsmagic.wingardium_leviosa.d: Hit a creature and keep holding to float it in front of you. Expert: also lifts a block (up to stone, nothing with an inventory); let go to set it down where it lands, or left-click while holding to throw what you hold (3 damage to whatever it hits). Master: holds two at once and a throw deals 6.
spell.hogwartsmagic.alohomora.desc: Unlocks doors, trapdoors and fence gates. Adept opens iron doors too (they swing shut after 5 seconds); Expert opens every door within 4 blocks and works out a small piston door lock (up to 4 levers or buttons) while you keep the cast held. At Master it cracks any piston door lock, combinations and button orders included, forcing a comparator, observer or sensor to fire if no switch will do; it also opens a Gringotts vault door from afar (the goblins still notice) and switches off a hostile Ward's barrier for 5 seconds.
spell.hogwartsmagic.incendio.desc: Sets creatures alight and lights campfires, candles, TNT and furnaces (ten seconds of fuel). From Adept the flames spread over flammable blocks around the impact, when fire spread and mob griefing are on.
spell.hogwartsmagic.stupefy.desc: A short, true stun that breaks any spell the target is casting. At Master it jumps to a second enemy.
spell.hogwartsmagic.revelio.desc: Reveals invisible mobs, highlights nearby ores and chests through walls (farther with each rank), and briefly breaks Cave Inimicum wards. From Expert, while you keep the cast held, it shows how a piston door opens: its levers and buttons glow, with the presses numbered. At Master it also reads item locks (which frame to fill and how far to turn it, how full a chest must be) and unmasks every Polyjuice disguise and Invisibility Cloak within 20 blocks for 5 seconds.
spell.hogwartsmagic.avada_kedavra.desc: The Killing Curse. A long windup that a hard hit, a stun or a silence can break, then death. Bosses lose 70% of their health instead. It hurts you too, less with rank, and not at all at Master.
spell.hogwartsmagic.crucio.desc: Keep holding after the curse lands: the victim is held in agony and hurt every half second while you stand still (2s, up to 5s at Master). At Master a surviving creature flees from you.
spell.hogwartsmagic.imperio.desc: Bends a creature to your will: it follows you and fights whatever you fight or whatever attacks you (20s for creatures, 3s for players and bosses, longer with rank; two thralls at Expert). At Master, keep holding to possess the target and see through its eyes.
spell.hogwartsmagic.fiendfyre.desc: Hold to loose serpents of cursed fire that follow your aim; hold attack to drive them further. Novice: one serpent for 6s, with a 15%% chance it turns on you (it glows red first). Adept: 8s, 8%%. Expert: 10s, 3%%, two serpents. Master: 12s, three serpents, never rogue; left-click while holding sends the next serpent at the creature you aim at, and the fire devours Horcruxes.
message.hogwartsmagic.fiendfyre.writhes: The Fiendfyre writhes against your will!
spell.hogwartsmagic.sectumsempra.desc: Invisible blades that leave the target bleeding: damage over time and no natural healing. Higher ranks open more wounds. At Master, striking a bleeding target tears every wound open at once.
spell.hogwartsmagic.morsmordre.desc: Summons the Dark Mark and waves of hostile mobs.
spell.hogwartsmagic.dolohov_curse.desc: A purple-flame curse that lowers the target's maximum health for a long while. Milk cannot lift it. At Master the curse leaps to nearby enemies when its victim dies.
spell.hogwartsmagic.incarcerous.desc: Chains from the ground tether the target to the spot. It can still fight, but can't get away. Higher ranks catch nearby enemies, pull flyers down and, at Master, chain everyone together.
spell.hogwartsmagic.heal.desc: Mends wounds on yourself (left-click) or a target (beam): 3 hearts, one more per rank. The only cure for bleeding (Adept) and cursed wounds (Master); milk can't wash either away.
spell.hogwartsmagic.tenebris_flight.desc: Death Eater Flight: Transform into black smoke for high-speed invulnerable flight. Expert: 30%% of arrows and spells that would hit you pass straight through. Master: 50%%, and flying into an enemy deals 5 damage and blinds it.

spell.hogwartsmagic.expecto_patronum.des: Hold to throw a shield of silver light that holds Dementors back while it drains your mana. Sometimes the charm answers in full and a corporeal Patronus takes the field: 15%% of casts at Novice, more as you rank up. A Master's Patronus follows you, lights the dark around you and drives the undead back.
spell.hogwartsmagic.bombarda.desc: Blasts open walls and tunnels, breaking blocks around the impact (never bedrock, spawners, containers or warded blocks). Weaker against creatures than Confringo. Higher ranks blast wider and break harder stone; at Master it breaks obsidian.
message.hogwartsmagic.bombarda.no_griefi: The blast leaves the ground alone here (mobGriefing is off).
spell.hogwartsmagic.depulso.desc: Banishes the target backwards; slam it into a wall for extra damage (3, up to 8 at Master). Expert: also blasts back enemies around the impact and turns incoming arrows and fireballs around. Master: a target thrown into another mob hurts both.
spell.hogwartsmagic.levicorpus.desc: Dangles the target in the air by their ankles: no items, no shield. At Master, cast it again to drop them hard.
spell.hogwartsmagic.diffindo.desc: A precise severing charm that cuts partly through armour. It also cuts leaves, vines, webs, wool and grass free as items, and shears sheep. At Master it cleaves a second enemy behind the first.
spell.hogwartsmagic.petrificus_totalus.d: A full body-bind: the target topples over, rigid, until the lock wears off or damage breaks it. At Master the breaking hit deals half again as much.
spell.hogwartsmagic.aqua_eructo.desc: Shoots a blast of water that extinguishes fires and heavily damages fiery creatures.
spell.hogwartsmagic.obliviate.desc: Wipes a creature's memory of you: it drops its target and leaves you alone until you strike it (5s, up to 30s at Master). Silences players. At Master it also forgets its raid and its home. Bosses resist it. A grey charm: each cast darkens your soul a little.
spell.hogwartsmagic.ascendio.desc: Aim down (or crouch-cast) to launch yourself 6 blocks up, 15 at Master, with no fall damage for 5 seconds; aim at a creature to toss it. Expert: cast again in midair for a second boost. Master: shoot up through water, and shove nearby enemies away as you take off.
spell.hogwartsmagic.confundo.desc: Muddles a creature so it turns on the nearest other creature (5s, up to 12s at Master). Players reel with nausea. At Master the confusion spreads to the creatures it hits (never players or bosses). Bosses resist it. A grey charm: each cast darkens your soul a little.
spell.hogwartsmagic.cave_inimicum.desc: Anchors a protected illusion to a ward block. Outside viewers see the frozen snapshot; inside viewers see reality.
spell.hogwartsmagic.alatus.desc: Channels flight magic into a Broom Workbench that holds a valid recipe. The infusion takes 5.5s (Novice), 4s (Adept), 3s (Expert) or 2s (Master). Adept: 15%% chance of a Fine broom (+5%% speed). Expert: Fine 30%%, Masterwork 5%% (+10%% speed, +15%% boost stamina). Master: Fine 40%%, Masterwork 15%%, and you can re-infuse a finished broom with 4 Arcane Dust to reroll its quality.
spell.hogwartsmagic.serpensortia.desc: Conjures snakes loyal to you that bite with poison: 1 for 20s (Novice), 2 for 30s (Adept), 3 for 40s with Poison II (Expert), 3 for 60s (Master). At Master you speak Parseltongue: left-click to send your snakes at a creature, or to switch them between following you and guarding a spot. Wild snakes leave a Master alone.
spell.hogwartsmagic.arresto_momentum.des: Softens a fall and bleeds away momentum. Self-cast to survive a plunge or strike a target to slow its descent. Expert: arrows, tridents, fireballs and venom within 4 blocks of where it lands (around you on a self-cast) stop in midair for 2s, then drop. It never stops spells. Master: 6 blocks.
spell.hogwartsmagic.reparo.desc: Rebuilds recently broken blocks near where it lands, paid with their rubble or matching blocks: 4 within 6 blocks at Novice, up to 48 within 20 at Master. From Expert, left-click mends the item in your off-hand (or your worn armour) by a tenth of its durability.
spell.hogwartsmagic.apparition.desc: Pick a spot on the map while you focus, then Disapparate with a crack and reappear there; anyone within a block comes with you. Range grows from 48 blocks at Novice to 200 at Master; the focus always takes 4 seconds. Novices risk being Splinched; Masters never are, and can Apparate to any Floo fireplace they have used in this dimension. A hit breaks your focus. Cannot be cast inside an anti-Apparition ward.

gui.hogwartsmagic.dark.redeemed: Healing another eases the darkness in you.
gui.hogwartsmagic.dark.escort_arrives: Death Eaters answer the Mark. They will guard you for five minutes.
message.hogwartsmagic.floo.not_owner: This fireplace belongs to someone else.
advancement.hogwartsmagic.cart_ride.desc: Ride a Gringotts cart all the way to the bottom. Hold on to your hat. And your lunch.
advancement.hogwartsmagic.thiefs_downfal: Pass through the Thief's Downfall and lose every disguise you were fond of.
advancement.hogwartsmagic.vault_opened.d: Open a vault door at Gringotts. A goblin would have used one finger.
advancement.hogwartsmagic.ironbelly_cowe: Ring the Clankers at a Ukrainian Ironbelly, or free one from its chains.
advancement.hogwartsmagic.diagon_alley.d: Tap the right brick and step through into Diagon Alley.
advancement.hogwartsmagic.duel_victor.de: Win a formal wand duel against a wizard or student.
advancement.hogwartsmagic.apparition.des: Apparate to a new place without leaving anything behind.
advancement.hogwartsmagic.corporeal_patr: Conjure a corporeal Patronus. Think of something happy. Harder than it sounds.
advancement.hogwartsmagic.hippogriff_tam: Win the trust of a Hippogriff. Manners cost nothing.
advancement.hogwartsmagic.invisibility_c: Get hold of an Invisibility Cloak.
Catch the Golden Snitch from the back of a broom.
Raise a Whomping Willow sapling. It will not hit you. Probably.
Bind a Horcrux. Some things are not worth the price.
guide.hogwartsmagic.welcome.letter.title: A Letter for New Witches and Wizards
guide.hogwartsmagic.welcome.letter.1: Welcome, young witch or wizard. If this handbook has found its way into your hands, your first steps into a larger magical life have already begun.
guide.hogwartsmagic.welcome.letter.2: Do not be troubled if everything feels vast. HogwartsMagic is a world of study, strange creatures, hidden routes, enchanted tools, and spells best learned with patience rather than panic.
guide.hogwartsmagic.welcome.letter.3: You need not master everything at once. Begin with a wand, a few humble spells, and enough good sense to know when to run.
guide.hogwartsmagic.welcome.first_days.1: Read your invitation and keep this guide close.
guide.hogwartsmagic.welcome.first_days.2: Find or craft a wand before chasing grander ambitions.
guide.hogwartsmagic.welcome.first_days.3: Study spellbooks whenever fortune places one in your path, for learned magic stays with you.
guide.hogwartsmagic.welcome.first_days.4: When the moment feels right, place the Sorting Hat upon your head and discover the house that will shape your path.
guide.hogwartsmagic.survival.staying_ali: Mana is precious in the beginning. A clever charm cast at the right moment is worth more than three dramatic mistakes.
Lumos, Alohomora, Accio, Arresto Momentum, and other practical magic will often serve you better than reckless curses.
Keep food on hand, carry a mundane weapon, and remember that courage does not require foolishness.
guide.hogwartsmagic.survival.older_stude: Face dangerous enemies in open places where movement and escape are still possible.
Use control spells before damage spells when panic sets in. A frozen foe is easier to survive than a merely injured one.
Do not wander into the darkest corners of the forest or the world until you have prepared for what hunts there.
guide.hogwartsmagic.survival.sleepless_n: Stay awake too long and the night will notice. After five full days without lying down in a bed, Dementors begin to drift in from the dark to find you. A few never left the Dementor Fen at all.
It happens only in the overworld, under open sky, after sunset or in a thunderstorm, and never on Peaceful. A night in a bed starts the count over.

Expecto Patronum is the answer. Held while you stand your ground, it throws a wall of silver light that stops them cold but cannot hurt them. Now and then, roughly one cast in seven, the charm answers in full: a corporeal stag that hunts Dementors down.
guide.hogwartsmagic.survival.death_eater: Build something worth wanting and the Death Eaters will hear of it. Wards, Horcruxes, Floo fireplaces, wandmaker's and broom benches, owl perches, cauldrons, enchanted book piles and moving portraits all mark a house as a wizard's, and enough of them in one place can bring a raid down on you.

It comes rarely, never twice within forty-five minutes by default, and only in the overworld on any difficulty above Peaceful. A bar appears at the top of the screen while the raiders are about. Clear them and it ends.
The grander the house, the likelier the visit. Keep your wand ready and your defences in order.
guide.hogwartsmagic.survival.trees_that_: The Whomping Willow stands in clearings of the old woods and does not like company. Read the entry under Creatures before you go near it.
Do not fly over it, do not linger in reach, and bring fire.
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.study.title: On the study of spells
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.study.1: Spellbooks are the proper way to grow your magical repertoire. Once a spell is learned, it may be selected on your wand and arranged for quick use.
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.study.2: There is no shame in relying on simple charms. Every accomplished duelist knows that timing and control matter more than spectacle.
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.disciplines.1: Practical charms: Lumos, Alohomora, Revelio, Reparo.
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.disciplines.2: Control and defense: Glacius, Wingardium Leviosa, Stupefy, Petrificus Totalus, Protego.
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.disciplines.3: Battle magic: Confringo, Bombarda, Sectumsempra, Diffindo.
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.disciplines.4: Forbidden and dangerous arts: Crucio, Imperio, Fiendfyre, Avada Kedavra, Morsmordre.
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.wheel.title: The spell wheel
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.wheel.1: Right-click with a wand casts your selected spell. Left-click casts it on yourself.
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.wheel.2: Hold R to open the Wand Spell Wheel, point at a slot and let go to choose it. Shift + right-click opens the full spell menu, where you fill the nine slots from the spells you have learned. Each slot can also be given a key of its own under Controls.
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.wheel.3: Spellbooks teach spells: right-click one to learn it. They turn up in chests and ruins, and now and then as a prize for winning a duel.
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.wheel.4: Press G for the Grimoire, which lists every spell in the world, which of them you have learned, where their books are to be found, and how far along each one is.
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.mastery.title: Spell mastery
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.mastery.1: Every spell has four ranks: Novice, Adept, Expert and Master. You rise by using a spell for real: striking a living thing, working a charm on a block, or finishing a self-cast. Casting again and again against the same thing earns little, allies earn nothing, mobs from spawners earn half and peaceful beasts a quarter.
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.mastery.2: By default Adept needs 30 experience, Expert 120 and Master 350. Each rank above Novice trims the spell's mana cost and cooldown by eight percent, adds a point to your maximum mana (up to fifty across every spell), and changes the spell itself. A rank-up is announced in the chat, and the chat line tells you what changed.
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.tomes.title: Tomes of Mastery
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.tomes.1: A Tome of Mastery raises one spell you already know by a single rank. Right-click it and choose the spell.
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.tomes.2: Tomes come in four tiers, Common, Uncommon, Rare and Epic, and a tome only lifts spells of its own tier or lower. They are found in chests, and the finest lie only in the deepest places: Gringotts vaults, the Horntail's nest and the Chamber.
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.duels.title: Duels
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.duels.1: To challenge a wizard or a student, hold a wand, crouch and right-click them. They bow, a count of three is called, and then it begins. Land a blow before the count ends and the duel is forfeit, and they will defend themselves in earnest.
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.duels.2: You win by Disarming them with Expelliarmus, or by wearing them down to a quarter of their health, at which point they yield. You lose if you are Disarmed or fall to two hearts. Stray more than thirty paces from them, or let two minutes pass, and the duel is called off.
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.duels.3: A win earns experience and sometimes a spellbook: about one time in three from a wizard, one in five from a student. The loser concedes and will not duel again for half a minute. A Death Eater is a wizard too, and may not be so gracious in defeat.
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.apparition.1: Apparition is a spell, and one of the hardest to find: its books are among the rarest. Cast it with a wand and you spend 100 mana at once, then concentrate for four seconds while a map of the land around you opens. Choose a spot and you vanish with a crack and arrive there.
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.apparition.2: How far you can go depends on mastery: 48 blocks at Novice, 80 at Adept, 128 at Expert and 200 at Master. Anyone standing within a block of you is carried along. Being struck while you concentrate breaks the spell, and a Cave Inimicum ward forbids leaving from, or arriving inside, its bounds.
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.apparition.3: Haste has a price. A jump can splinch: you land short, take eight points of damage, are withered and dizzied, and leave one stack of your belongings behind. By default the chance is one in ten at Novice, half that at Adept, a fifth of it at Expert and nothing at Master.
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.apparition.4: A Master can also jump straight to any Floo fireplace they have used, at any distance, within the same dimension.
Ways of the wider magical world
Houses grant identity and subtle advantage.
Wand cores change the temperament of your casting.
Relics strengthen your reserves or replenish your magic more swiftly.
Owls and Floo hearths tie distant places together once you have built the right infrastructure.
guide.hogwartsmagic.systems.floo.title: Floo fireplaces
guide.hogwartsmagic.systems.floo.1: Craft a Floo Fireplace and a Floo Binding Token. Use the token on a fireplace to name it. Then use it on one named fireplace and on another to link the pair; the link runs both ways. A fireplace belongs to whoever first named or linked it.
guide.hogwartsmagic.systems.floo.2: To travel, stand on the fireplace's soul flames, drop Floo Powder onto them and pick a destination from the list of linked fires. Every fire you travel between is remembered, which matters once you master Apparition.
guide.hogwartsmagic.systems.owl_post.1: Tame an owl with wheat seeds and build two Owl Perches. Use an Owl Route Tag on each perch in turn to link them.
guide.hogwartsmagic.systems.owl_post.2: Right-click a perch with an item and it is queued for delivery. A tame owl of your own, close enough to the perch, will carry it across to the linked perch, where it can be taken with an empty hand.
guide.hogwartsmagic.systems.owl_post.3: Hand a linked Owl Route Tag to your owl and it will serve only that route.
guide.hogwartsmagic.systems.brooms.title: Brooms and the Snitch
guide.hogwartsmagic.systems.brooms.1: Use a broom to set it down in front of you, then right-click it to climb on. Fly with the movement keys and hold sprint to boost. The engine tires: drain its stamina and the boost locks until it recovers. Sneak to climb down.
guide.hogwartsmagic.systems.brooms.2: Jump while pushing left or right for a barrel roll, or while pushing forward for a loop.
guide.hogwartsmagic.systems.brooms.3: A Golden Snitch can be released, if you have one. Mount a broom, chase it down and fly close enough to catch it.
guide.hogwartsmagic.systems.mysteries.1: Cave Inimicum wards may conceal what lies within from unfriendly eyes.
guide.hogwartsmagic.systems.mysteries.2: Polyjuice allows disguise, though not always wisdom.
guide.hogwartsmagic.systems.mysteries.3: Horcrux rites and the blackest branches of magic are best left for the truly prepared, or the truly lost.
guide.hogwartsmagic.systems.dark_rite.1: The darkest working in this book is an arrangement more than a spell. It wants three Wards, laid on one level, none further than four paces from the one you strike. A Ward is wrought from amethyst, Arcane Dust, Fine Wood and a Centaur's talisman.
guide.hogwartsmagic.systems.dark_rite.2: Set two of them four paces apart on a straight line. Set the third two paces to the side of the point halfway between them. Seen from above, it is a roof: two equal slopes, and a flat base.
guide.hogwartsmagic.systems.dark_rite.3: Then cast Morsmordre at any one of the three. If the shape is true, the Mark will answer. What it calls is not to be met unprepared.
guide.hogwartsmagic.gringotts.finding.1: Gringotts keeps a branch on the outskirts of roughly one village in three, about seventy blocks out from the village bell and facing back toward it. It is enormous. You will not mistake it.
guide.hogwartsmagic.gringotts.finding.2: The goblin tellers in the hall trade in Galleons: two for a gold ingot, six for a diamond, three to buy an ingot back. They also sell wand wood, brooms and silver daggers, at a price.
guide.hogwartsmagic.gringotts.gate.title: The hall and the gate
guide.hogwartsmagic.gringotts.gate.1: The vaults lie beyond an iron-barred screen at the back of the hall. The gate in it opens for goblins only. Polyjuice yourself into one and a bare hand will swing it wide for eight seconds without anyone looking up.
guide.hogwartsmagic.gringotts.gate.2: Otherwise it must be forced. The bars are goblin-forged and take about twelve seconds a block, and the very first blow brings every guard in the hall. Alohomora does nothing here, and that is the hint.
guide.hogwartsmagic.gringotts.cart.title: The lift and the cart
guide.hogwartsmagic.gringotts.cart.1: Past the gate is a round hall with a plinth over a deep shaft. That is the lift. Stand on it to be carried down, or take the stair that winds down the same shaft.
guide.hogwartsmagic.gringotts.cart.2: At the bottom the carts wait. Climb into one, press forward to set off, and back to brake. The line plunges and banks at speed and ends at the vaults.
guide.hogwartsmagic.gringotts.cart.3: Halfway down hangs the Thief's Downfall, a curtain of enchanted water. It strips every potion effect, your Polyjuice and your Invisibility Cloak, and leaves you blind and soaked for a moment, though it does not throw you from the cart. Whatever you were pretending to be, you arrive as yourself.
guide.hogwartsmagic.gringotts.vaults.1: A vault door opens to an empty hand laid flat against it. Anything held gets in the way. Cogs and bolts turn for ten seconds and then the doorway stands open. A goblin does it quietly. Anyone else sets off the alarm, and a vault the bank knows about shuts itself again about a minute later.
guide.hogwartsmagic.gringotts.vaults.2: The bank keeps a count of how angry it is with you, from one to four. Opening a chest in the vaults adds one. Forcing the gate or opening a vault adds two. From two upward, four more guards appear at the way out. The count falls by one for every ten minutes you spend outside the bank.
The deepest vaults are guarded by a Ukrainian Ironbelly, chained by the leg and kept in the dark so long that it barely sees. It hunts by sound. Sprinting and breaking blocks call it to you. Walking does not. So walk.

Clankers, found in the vault chests, will cow it for a while within twenty blocks, but the same din calls every guard within thirty-two. The chains are anchored by lightning-rod stubs in the floor: break the last one and the dragon leaves of its own accord. Kill it instead, if you can, and it may leave a dragon heartstring behind.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.friends_an: Not every beast in this world is an enemy. Owls and Hippogriffs may become treasured companions, and a Patronus can be a shining guardian in darker hours.
Yet other beings are no mere nuisance. Death Eaters, Dementors, Basilisks, and forest horrors demand respect.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.warnings.1: If a foe commands spells, never stand still for long.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.warnings.2: If a creature rules the sky, answer with movement or cover.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.warnings.3: If a place feels ancient, cursed, or unwelcome, trust that feeling.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.hippogriff: A Hippogriff is proud, and rudeness is the one thing it does not forgive. Crouch, approach slowly and wait for it to bow, then bow back. Rush it, or hit it, and it will turn on you.

Once it has accepted you, offer it raw rabbit. It may take the meat and bind itself to you, or it may not, in which case offer another. A tame Hippogriff stays where you leave it, and will carry you if you ask.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.house_elve: A wild house elf keeps to itself deep in the Forbidden Forest, always alone. A few still keep the kitchens of the castle.

It vanishes with a crack the instant it notices a wizard, so you must either go unnoticed - an Invisibility Cloak, an invisibility potion, Polyjuice worn as some beast, or a slow and patient crouch - or hold it fast where it stands.
Cave Inimicum forbids Apparition within its bounds. Petrificus Totalus, Incarcerous, Glacius, Stupefy, Arresto Momentum and the Imperius Curse will each serve as well.
Offer food to an elf that cannot flee and it will bind itself to you as master.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.basilisk.1: The King of Serpents runs fourteen paces from snout to tail tip, and its stare is death. Not at once - it takes hold slowly, and the world goes grey at the edges while it works.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.basilisk.2: Look away and the hold breaks. Break the line of sight and it breaks faster. Fight it by the edges of your vision, never square on, and never stand admiring it.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.basilisk.3: It rears before it strikes, which is the only warning you are given. At a distance it spits venom that eats the ground where it lands, and if you keep out of reach it will simply go under the earth and come up beneath you.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.basilisk.4: Blows landed on the head will in time put its eyes out, and a blinded basilisk cannot petrify at all. It hunts by sound thereafter - so walk, do not run, and crouch when it casts about for you.
The Black Lake is inhabited. Deep down, past where the light gives out, there is a village of stone dwellings under a great statue of a merchieftainess, and the people who built it are watching you swim over their roofs.

They are Beings, not beasts, and they will let you pass. Linger over the village and one will rear up, spread its fins and cry out at you - a warning, and the only one you are given. Take it and go, and nothing happens at all.

Ignore it, or raise a hand to any one of them, and every merperson for twenty yards comes at once with a spear. They are faster than you in the water and they know it. Their chieftainess is larger, paler, and worse.
Their speech is a real language, though above the surface it is nothing but a hideous screeching. Put your head under and listen properly and you will hear them singing.
A spear taken from one is a poor weapon in air and a wicked one below the water.

There is a hoard laid at the statue's feet, and a second stash behind the dwellings. Lift the lid of either and every merperson in the water knows it, at once, and they do not forget it quickly. Whatever is in there, decide first whether you can swim faster than they can.

In the hoard lies a crown of a chieftainess long drowned. Wear it and the lake is yours: you will breathe its water and see through it as though you were born to it, and you will never need Gillyweed again.

But wear it where they can see you and there is no rearing up, no screeching, no warning of any kind. You are wearing their chieftainess. They come at once, and they keep coming. You may have the freedom of the lake or the goodwill of the people in it. You will not have both.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.grindylows: A grindylow is a small horned water demon, sickly green, with a head too big for it, a mouth full of needles and six curling tentacles where its legs ought to be. The merpeople keep them the way a farmer keeps dogs.

It will not duel you. It lies in the weed doing nothing whatever until something wakes it, and then it comes with its fellows, and what it does when it reaches you is not to wound you. It takes hold of your leg, drags you down and waits.
There is a nest of them asleep around the hoard. Open that chest and you will find out exactly what they were put there for.
Do not thrash. Their fingers are long and strong and they are also brittle: strike the thing holding you, however feebly, and it lets go at once. Then deal with the next one.
You can see them before they see you, if you look. Their eyes carry a light of their own, and two green points low in the weed are the only warning you will get.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.giants.1: A giant stands more than three men tall and wanders the deepest forest alone, muttering to itself and pulling at the trees.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.giants.2: Left be, it will leave you be. Strike it, or linger too long at its feet, and it will announce itself with a roar you will feel through the soles of your boots.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.giants.3: It swings a backhand that will throw you clear across a clearing, and kicks the ground apart - earth, timber, glass and thatch all give way, though good stone will not.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.giants.4: Worst of all, it will simply pick you up and throw you. Do not count on the landing. It is no gentler with the beasts of the forest than it is with wizards.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.willow.1: There is a tree in the old woods that is not only a tree. It stands still while you are far off, and it is still standing still when you are close enough to regret it.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.willow.2: It cannot follow you. That is the whole of the trick: everything it can reach, it can reach at once, and everything past that is safe. Watch which way a branch draws back - sideways for a sweep, straight up for a hammer, and all four at once when it means to shake the ground.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.willow.3: Fly over it at your peril. It will pick a broom out of the air, though a rider so struck seems to fall more gently than they ought.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.willow.4: Look low on the trunk for the knot. Press it and the whole tree goes slack, and stays so until something disturbs it. Those of a practical bent have been known to run a wire to it and lay a plate in the path, so that the tree sleeps for anyone who walks the road and wakes for anyone who does not.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.willow.5: Fire is what it fears; an axe is next best. Arrows only lodge in the bark, and left alone it closes its own wounds.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.willow.6: Cut one down and you may find a whip of it still living. Plant that, let it come up, and take it by the hand when it is grown - it will know you, and it will know everyone else is not you.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.freeing_el: A bound elf serves, and blames itself with its own fists whenever harm comes to its master.
Present it with clothing - any garment at all - and it is free.
But it remembers how it was taken. One brought in gently stays on as a friend, Apparating to your side and hurling aside any who raise a hand to you.
One taken by force takes the clothes, and is gone. Choose accordingly.
guide.hogwartsmagic.crafting.wands.title: Choosing a wand
guide.hogwartsmagic.crafting.wands.1: Wandmaker villagers, who keep their trade at a Wandmaker's Bench, sell wands. Your first purchase is no ordinary sale: Ollivander himself takes your measure, and the scene is well worth watching to the end.
guide.hogwartsmagic.crafting.wands.2: Or make your own. A Wand Blank of Fine Wood, a core and an Arcane Core go together at the Wandmaker's Bench. Phoenix feather gives fast beams and a quick rhythm. Unicorn hair is thrifty with mana and may refund a sliver of the cost. Dragon heartstring hits hard, slowly, and thirstily.
guide.hogwartsmagic.crafting.wands.3: Dragon heartstring is the hardest core to come by. A Hungarian Horntail or a Ukrainian Ironbelly may yield one when slain, or one can be built at a crafting table from a Nether Star and a good deal of Arcane Dust.
guide.hogwartsmagic.crafting.benches.1: The Wandmaker's Bench is where proper wands are born from fine wood, magical cores, and careful intention.
guide.hogwartsmagic.crafting.benches.2: The Broom Workbench requires ingredients first and Alatus afterward, for flight in this world is infused rather than simply assembled.
guide.hogwartsmagic.crafting.benches.3: Rare creature parts, arcane materials, and relics are not trinkets. Keep them.
guide.hogwartsmagic.crafting.broom_recip: Lay the ingredients out on the Broom Workbench, then cast Alatus on the bench itself. Nothing is made until the spell lands.

A plain broom wants a Fine Wood Stick, Wheat, Arcane Dust and Iron. A Nimbus 2000 wants that broom with a Phantom Membrane, a Netherite Ingot and an Arcane Core. A Firebolt wants a Nimbus with a Netherite Ingot, an Elytra and a Dragon Heartstring Core.
A Master of Alatus can re-infuse a finished broom with four Arcane Dust, to try again for a finer one.
guide.hogwartsmagic.crafting.build_first: A trustworthy wand should come before vanity.
A broom is more than a luxury; it is often the difference between escape and disaster.
Treat every new station as a doorway into another branch of magical life.
guide.hogwartsmagic.dark_magic.weight.1: Every curse marks the one who casts it. The Killing Curse, Fiendfyre, Morsmordre, the Imperius and Cruciatus Curses, Tenebris Flight, Sectumsempra, Dolohov's Curse and Serpensortia all darken the soul, whether they strike or miss.
guide.hogwartsmagic.dark_magic.weight.2: The Killing Curse weighs heaviest and Serpensortia least. Ten Killing Curses will take a clean soul to Corrupted.
guide.hogwartsmagic.dark_magic.weight.3: Killing an innocent with it weighs more still, and tearing your soul into a Horcrux most of all.
guide.hogwartsmagic.dark_magic.weight.4: Your Grimoire names the state of your soul. No book shows it to anyone else.
guide.hogwartsmagic.dark_magic.weight.5: Obliviate and Confundo are grey: they darken you a little.
guide.hogwartsmagic.dark_magic.five_stat: The five states of a soul
Clean, Shadowed, Tainted, Corrupted, Lost. A low bell tolls when you sink further; a chime sounds when you rise.
From Corrupted your mana runs a dark green-black.
A curse cast through a body you have taken with the Imperius Curse darkens you, never your puppet.
guide.hogwartsmagic.dark_magic.costs.1: Shadowed: your Patronus takes its full form only half as often.
guide.hogwartsmagic.dark_magic.costs.2: Tainted: it answers only as a shield, and Dementors come for the sleepless after three days instead of five.
guide.hogwartsmagic.dark_magic.costs.3: Corrupted: the shield drinks more of your mana, Dementors seek you before all others, students keep their distance, and a faint smoke clings to you.
guide.hogwartsmagic.dark_magic.costs.4: Lost: a heart of your life is gone, students attack on sight, and even your own house elf flees you.
guide.hogwartsmagic.dark_magic.costs.5: Yet your Patronus never fails. Rise out of the darkness and students and Dementors forget you at once.
guide.hogwartsmagic.dark_magic.offers.1: From Corrupted, dark spells cost less mana, and the Dark Mark lends you its strength as it does the Death Eaters.
guide.hogwartsmagic.dark_magic.offers.2: The Lost walk among Death Eaters unchallenged until they strike one, by wand, fire or steam.
guide.hogwartsmagic.dark_magic.offers.3: Cast the Mark into an open sky and they come to guard you for five minutes, each where it finds safe ground to stand. They remain what they are.
guide.hogwartsmagic.dark_magic.offers.4: The Dark Lord and those who guard him are not so easily fooled.
Darkness fades once you let the dark arts rest for ten minutes: one step for every half hour you spend in this world, about ten hours for each state. From the very bottom it takes some fifty.
Heal another who is hurt and you may hasten it, though no more than once in each half hour.
While its Horcrux stands, a soul already Corrupted or darker cannot fade below Corrupted.
A Sneakoscope whistles at a Corrupted or Lost soul, cloak or no cloak.
Slytherins darken more slowly; Hufflepuffs find their way back faster.
guide.hogwartsmagic.spells.disciplines.5: Riddikulus: the charm that turns a boggart into a joke and, with enough hits, laughs it away.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.boggarts.1: A boggart is a shape-shifter. It has no shape of its own. It hides in dark, closed places and waits.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.boggarts.2: When you come near, it wears the shape of the creature that has killed you most often. It wears a Dementor's shape if that killer was a wizard. Its fear spreads darkness and heavy legs to everyone close by.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.boggarts.3: How to spot one: a dark shape that stands still in a dark room. It smokes a little. Nothing else in the castle stands so still.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.boggarts.4: How to beat it: cast Riddikulus. Each hit makes it smaller and sillier. A Novice needs three hits, an Adept two, an Expert two, and a Master one. On the last hit it bursts into laughter and smoke.
guide.hogwartsmagic.creatures.boggarts.5: Walk away and it hides again in a few breaths, whole and unhurt. It does not forget. Neither should you.
guide.hogwartsmagic.potions.the_wizard_c: Set the cauldron over heat: a lit campfire or soul campfire, fire, soul fire, lava or a magma block.
Fill it with a water bucket, or three water bottles. Ingredients go only into a full cauldron.
Right-click with each ingredient, one at a time. Stir with a Fine Wood Stick: right-click to stir clockwise, sneak and right-click to stir anticlockwise (keep your other hand empty).
Simmer steps count down only while there is heat. Right-click with an empty hand to read the brew.
guide.hogwartsmagic.potions.signs_in_the: Every correct step changes the colour of the brew. A wrong step turns it grey-brown with a hiss of smoke: the brew is ruined.
A finished brew shimmers and chimes. Left on the heat more than 120 seconds after its last simmer, it boils into ruin. Take the heat away and it keeps forever.
A glass bottle takes one dose, and a brew gives three. A ruined brew bottles as Failed Potion, or an empty bucket pours it away.
Stir in a steady rhythm, about one turn a second; a chime means the turn was true. Fine ingredients and true stirring make a stronger potion.
guide.hogwartsmagic.potions.wiggenweld_p: Heals 8 health over about two seconds and stops Bleeding.
guide.hogwartsmagic.potions.pepperup_pot: Restores 40 mana and gives 30 seconds of Fire Resistance. Steam pours from your ears.
guide.hogwartsmagic.potions.polyjuice_po: Turns the drinker into whoever the sample came from.
guide.hogwartsmagic.potions.polyjuice_th: Fill it with a Sample Collector: use it on a player or a mob.
6. Add a filled Polyjuice Sample. An empty one is refused. Take the cauldron off the heat while you fetch the sample, or it overbrews.
Then, if you like, in this order: 1 Redstone Dust for an 8-minute disguise, then 1 Gunpowder to make every dose a splash potion.
The brew gives 3 doses, each carrying the same sample. The brewing stand no longer makes Polyjuice.
guide.hogwartsmagic.potions.essence_of_d: Closes a Cursed Wound and heals 4 health.
guide.hogwartsmagic.potions.mandrake_res: Brings back anyone the basilisk has turned to stone.
guide.hogwartsmagic.potions.using_the_ma: Right-click a petrified friend, or a stone statue, with a bottle to bring them back.
Add 1 Gunpowder after the Arcane Dust and every dose becomes a splash potion that frees all the stone within 4 blocks.
Drunk, it breaks a basilisk's hold on you and steadies your eyes for 8 seconds. A friend you bring back is safe from the gaze for 8 seconds too.
guide.hogwartsmagic.potions.advanced_int: Libatius Borage sets out the brews that ordinary students are not trusted with. They use the same cauldron, the same stirring rod and the same patience, only less forgiveness.
You learn these recipes by reading this book once. After that they are yours for good, even if you lose the book or die, and any cauldron will take your steps.
Reading is personal: a friend who has not read it is still refused at the cauldron. Hand them the book.
guide.hogwartsmagic.potions.draught_of_l: A splash potion: everything within 4 blocks falls into a deathlike sleep for 20 seconds. The great shrug off half of it, and it wears thinner on a victim struck again soon.
guide.hogwartsmagic.potions.living_death: 5. Stir clockwise once. The brew turns clear as water.
Seven anticlockwise, then one clockwise. Do not trust the old textbook.
guide.hogwartsmagic.potions.felix_felici: Liquid luck: 3 minutes of Luck III, and every spell you master grows a quarter faster. The brew gives a single dose.
Take it off the heat after the simmer if you must leave it: it overbrews like any other.
The clear truth-serum. Give it to someone: a villager confesses and warms to you, a Death Eater betrays the friends nearby, a disguise falls away. The brew gives three doses.
guide.hogwartsmagic.potions.veritaserum_: You will need: Feather, Amethyst Shard, Valerian Sprigs, Arcane Dust.
A villager confesses once a day and thinks better of you. Death Eaters give up every accomplice within 48 blocks: they glow for half a minute. The great ones resist.
On another player it works only where you could strike them: it breaks a Polyjuice disguise, shows a cloak and makes them glow. Drunk, it does the same to you.
guide.hogwartsmagic.potions.advanced_boo: Some brews are not in any ordinary guide: the Draught of Living Death, Felix Felicis. They are taught by Libatius Borage's Advanced Potion-Making.
The Bookseller in Diagon Alley sells a copy once he has settled in, and now and then one sits in the ingredient chests of the Potions classroom at Mini Hogwarts.
Until you have read it, the cauldron will refuse the first step of those recipes and take nothing from you.
guide.hogwartsmagic.potions.potion_of_re: Painful to drink: it hurts, sickens and weakens you, but it lightens a darkened soul by 5 points, once every two hours of play. It does nothing for a clean soul or one held at the Horcrux floor, and then costs you no waiting.
You will need a Ghast Tear, dropped by a Ghast in the Nether.
guide.hogwartsmagic.potions.where_ingred: Dittany grows on earth and bare rock in the Forbidden Forest and the Horntail Peaks. A wild plant gives two; one you plant gives back one.
Apothecaries sell Dittany, Valerian Sprigs, Asphodel and Wormwood, each shop only some of them.
Valerian Sprigs turn up in the chests of the Hogwarts ruin camp.
Ashwinder Eggs: Death Eater camps, the Chamber, and now and then a Blaze.
Wild dittany, pulled mandrakes, Ashwinder eggs from Blazes and the apothecary's best stock are fine ingredients.
guide.hogwartsmagic.potions.turned_to_st: A basilisk's full stare no longer kills you: it turns you to stone. You cannot move or act, and nothing can hurt you.
Wait for a friend with a Mandrake Restorative Draught, or give in and die as usual: choose it on the stone screen, or press J (by default) to open that screen again.
A creature turned to stone leaves a statue. The Draught brings it back as it was, with its name and its master. Break the statue, or push it into the void, and it is gone for good.
